id:
Sesuai kebiasaan bangsawan Makkah, beliau disusukan di pedesaan Bani Sa'd oleh Halimah as-Sa'diyah. Di masa kecil inilah terjadi peristiwa pembelahan dada. Anas bin Malik meriwayatkan bahwa Jibril datang saat beliau bermain dengan anak-anak, membelah dadanya, mengeluarkan segumpal darah dari hatinya sambil berkata "Ini bagian setan darimu", lalu mencucinya dengan air Zamzam dalam bejana emas dan mengembalikannya.

Pelajaran: Allah menjaga dan menyiapkan Nabi-Nya sejak kecil.
en:
Following the custom of Makkah's nobles, he was nursed in the countryside of Banu Sa'd by Halimah as-Sa'diyyah. During this childhood the opening of his chest took place. Anas ibn Malik narrated that Jibril came while he was playing with other boys, opened his chest, removed a clot from his heart saying "This was Satan's share of you", washed it with Zamzam water in a golden basin and restored it.

Lesson: Allah protected and prepared His Prophet from childhood.
